articles.title: Robot Hand Walks, Types and Plays Games on Its Fingers
articles.summary: A Swiss team built a robot hand that balances on uneven fingers, types with 29 of 32 keys correct and plays the puzzle game Sokoban. It is inspired by Thing from The Addams Family.

articles.title: Role Model Debates Maine Fame on Chicken Shop Date
articles.summary: Singer Role Model joked on Chicken Shop Date about whether he is Maine's most famous celebrity, naming Stephen King and Anna Kendrick. His album Chuck Timely & The Hourglass hit the top 10.

articles.title: Michael McDonald Reconnects With Son He Placed for Adoption at 14
articles.summary: Doobie Brothers singer Michael McDonald has reconnected with Michael Goessling, the son he placed for adoption nearly six decades ago. Goessling, 59, learned his father's identity last year.
